format: JCS envelope plus one LF; payload is a JCS JSON string
layout: Unpacked LLVM StructType of original declared fixed fields; base fields precede own fields. bool is ABI u8. LLVM target DataLayout produces sizes/alignments/offsets/stride; flow carriers never supply ABI.
numbers: All byte sizes, alignments, strides, offsets, version and UTF16 range coordinates are JSON integers. target.pointerBits remains the original Common target string, e.g. "64".

identity.payloadHash: sha256("tsfg.component-layout.v1\0" + exact payload UTF8 bytes, without LF)
identity.typeIds: existing semantic TypeIds; type rows and component IDs strict ascending order; every required fixed field/type is retained

ranges: Original UTF16 declaration ranges. Scalars use empty sourcePath and {start:0,end:0}. Fields retain original declaration sourcePath/range, including inherited fields.
fields: Original declared fields in base-before-own order; scalar has fields=[] and scalar=name; value/component has scalar="". An actual component is the original nominalKey.category=component marker, even when Source kind=reference.
qualification: Data only, checksum is integrity not authenticity or permission. No SourceTrap/Host/kernel/VM/GPU execution credit. CPU target layout is not a GPU ABI promise.
